column3: With respect to the Aura Hotel Times Square Mortgage Loan (4.3%), the related co-borrowers are the owner of the leased fee (land) interest and the leasehold (improvements) interest. Each co-borrower has encumbered its respective ownership interest to the lien of the Fee and Leasehold Mortgage. Accordingly, the Aura Hotel Times Square Mortgage Loan is presented as a Fee interest loan.
